test_jsonl_dataset_single_line: test the JsonlDataset class with a single line JSONL file to verify basic loading
test_jsonl_dataset_multiple_lines: test the JsonlDataset class with multiple lines to verify correct iteration and data retrieval
test_jsonl_cache_invalidation: test that removing the cache file forces JsonlDataset to rebuild from the updated JSONL source
test_jsonl_tokenizer_integration: test that a custom tokenizer function is applied lazily when accessing JsonlDataset items
test_jsonl_data_subsharding: test JsonlDataset subsharding across epochs to verify round-robin document selection with data_subshard_count
